title: Overbright asset format: the car type order (ob.car-index)
description: cars.md 3.1. global/cars/index.toml: the car types in the original's table order. A car type's position is its type index, which the engine's own tables use (engine-tables.md). Base sets only in 1.0; a mod pack holding this file is refused (MRG.3).

order.description: Car type names, position = type index (GLOBALB 0x34600 order). Each names global/cars/types/<NAME>.toml.
